title: Agent session analytics
requirement: Let the user inspect agent sessions across both coding agents (what ran, tool calls, tokens and cost per session) from local data, without a hosted service.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Coverage of both agents' local session formats, agreement of token totals with the clients' own counters, and time to answer a fixed set of questions about past sessions.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
